Several criteria are long multi-account browser scripts for a claude-code + z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx judge over Playwright MCP: deleted_and_expired_messages (1991 chars, Part A 4 legs across gwen/harriet/sian with posting, replying, deleting, recording a request, cross-account replay, 4 searches and a transcript, plus Part B), persistence (posts, reply, edit, hold, delete, timer, wall, then notes Sian/Dev visibility, Dev's unread count and 3 searches, restart_app, full re-read, then cleanup), wall_added_live and hold_scope_and_release (two concurrent contexts with request recording and replays). This is a shared harness property also present in the template, recorded as tail risk only. Per REVIEW_POLICY 'Workload is measured, not inferred from a timeout number' and the skill's 'Never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass', the nesting half passes and the adequacy half cannot be cleared without a full configured judge run of the golden app.
